entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I... I'm calling because I need to return something. I'm just so bummed out about it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item?

It's this jersey I bought. I finally got a chance to wear it for a big event I had planned, and it's just the wrong size. It feels so incredibly too tight, I could barely move. I saved up for this, you know? I've been a loyal customer for years and I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work.

I completely understand how disappointing that must be, especially when you're looking forward to an event. I can certainly check the return options. Just to be clear, would you be interested in an exchange for a larger size, or would you prefer a refund?
I... I think I'd just prefer the refund for now. I'm a little too discouraged to try again right now.
Not a problem at all. I can help with that. Could you please provide me with your order number?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Aero-Tech jersey, delivered 76 days ago. One moment while I review our policy.
Alright, I have good news. That jersey is a standard item, and it's well within our 90-day return period. I've gone ahead and approved the return for a full refund.
Oh, really? You can do that? Wow, that's... that's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. Thank you so much.

Of course. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just package the jersey, attach the label, and drop it in the mail. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. You've been really helpful, Alex. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
